aggregation: descriptive per-configuration observations only; n=1 so no SD, confidence intervals, or significance estimates
coverage_line: Mac: 24/24 valid observations (one per configuration, n=1); Android: 0/24 pending.
decode_line: Mac CPU decode observations span 26.34-83.66 tokens/s across different model, quantization, input, and output settings. Every point is n=1; compare only matched configurations.
context_line: Prefill rates were 110.5-597.0 tokens/s across 256-2,048 input tokens. Capacity was 3,072 positions; input length is not allocated cache.
results_overview: The exploratory Mac CPU presentation sweep completed all 24 unique main configurations. An independent audit checked prompt/request token identity, exact runtime input/output and SSE counts, limit stop reason, no truncation, no prompt-cache reuse, and runtime throughput denominators; all 24 passed. There is one observation per configuration (n=1), so these are descriptive points with no SD or repeatability estimate. Across unlike settings, runtime decode throughput ranged 26.34-83.66 tokens/s, request wall time 1.97-34.55 s, and sampled request-window process RSS 588-2131 MiB. Android remains pending.
results_detail: At the largest 2,048-input/512-output case, the four observed model/quantization points were: qwen05_q4 Q4_K_M: decode 60.15 tokens/s, request 15.21 s, sampled RSS 590 MiB; qwen05_q8 Q8_0: decode 61.42 tokens/s, request 14.87 s, sampled RSS 765 MiB; qwen15_q4 Q4_K_M: decode 30.40 tokens/s, request 34.55 s, sampled RSS 1181 MiB; qwen15_q8 Q8_0: decode 27.26 tokens/s, request 33.31 s, sampled RSS 2028 MiB. These are individual observations, not a model ranking. Across the 24 requests, CPU-temperature samples during requests ranged 74.7-92.9 C; GPU temperature was unavailable. A separate powermetrics log recorded nominal system thermal pressure in 1,071 samples, but temperature stabilization under the strict rule was not demonstrated. macmon component-power samples bracketed 22/24 request intervals sufficiently for gross component-rail integration; these are request-boundary estimates, not isolated decode energy or whole-device energy. Native caffeinate was enabled at 05:52:10 UTC during the sweep; 11/24 requests began before that power-management change. KV cache, WikiText-2 perplexity, monitoring-overhead, and operator-profiling studies were not run in this presentation scope.
conclusion_evidence: The evidence shows the pinned Mac CPU testbed completed each of the 24 exact-token configurations with the requested output count and no truncation or prompt-cache reuse. It supports descriptive observations for this Mac, model set, CPU build, and run context only. One sample per configuration cannot establish repeatability or statistical significance. Thermal stabilization was not demonstrated; CPU-temperature observations ranged widely and a power-management assertion changed during the sweep. No Android result exists, so no two-device comparison or phone-feasibility claim is supported. The full repeated protocol and Android handoff remain available for later completion.

figures.title: Runtime decode throughput by input length
figures.caption: One observation per point (n=1). Runtime decode tokens/s is the runtime predicted token count divided by predicted_ms. Panels separate checkpoint and output budget; lines connect the three input lengths. Descriptive only; no error bars.

figures.title: Request time and sampled process RSS at 512 generated tokens
figures.caption: One observation per point (n=1). Request wall time includes client request/stream delivery. RSS is sampled process RSS during each request, not lifetime maximum. Context capacity is fixed at 3,072; memory is not a linear KV-cache allocation curve.

figures.caption: macmon CPU+GPU+ANE power estimates integrated over the client request interval. Eleven of twelve 512-token points have adequate sample brackets. Gross request energy, n=1; not whole-device energy and not isolated decode J/token.
